info.name: Shopify Admin REST About Predictive Search API

params.name: resources[type]
params.description: Comma-separated resource types to search (product, page, article, collection, query)

params.name: resources[limit]
params.description: Number of results per type (1-10, default 10)

params.name: resources[limit_scope]
params.description: How the limit is distributed: all (shared across types) or each (per type)

params.name: resources[options][fields]
params.description: Comma-separated fields to search within (title, product_type, vendor, tag, variants.title, variants.sku, body)

items.docs: Retrieves predictive search results for a query string. Returns matching products, collections, pages, articles, and query suggestions. Used for search-as-you-type experiences.
